$comment: Catalog contract v1: the symbol vocabulary entries may reference. Entries embed command-free MXC 1.0 request access fields; each revision records its SDK validation target (sdkContractVersion). 'context' symbols come only from ResolveContext.projectRoot; 'caller' symbols come from ResolveContext.symbols, then host-local discovery, then a platform default; 'host' symbols are OS well-known folders derived for the current host, which ResolveContext.symbols may override. A 'defaults' map gives a per-platform path template that may reference only host symbols.

project_root.description: The consumer's project root, supplied through ResolveContext.projectRoot.

git_prefix.description: Directory containing the git executable (discovered on PATH when omitted).

node_prefix.description: Directory containing the node executable (discovered on PATH when omitted).

npm_prefix.description: Directory containing the npm and npx launchers (discovered on PATH when omitted).

npm_cache.description: The npm cache directory in effect for the invocation (discovered from npm_config_cache or ~/.npmrc when omitted).

ssh_prefix.description: Directory containing the ssh executable (discovered on PATH when omitted).

programData.description: The Windows common application-data directory (%ProgramData%). Derived only on a Windows host.

localAppData.description: The Windows per-user local application-data directory (%LOCALAPPDATA%). Derived only on a Windows host.
